name: disposable-augmentation-lab
description: Hand-authored fixture for well-known symbol keys a package augments onto SymbolConstructor when the program's lib omits them (W3). [Symbol.dispose] and [Symbol.asyncDispose] are declared by the compiler's lib and read as Emit members; [Symbol.observable] is not and stays dropped (MB002), as does a package-owned unique symbol. Tracked in git, no npm install.
